title: Incident Tracking System
description: A centralized incident management application designed to simplify how teams report, assign, monitor, and resolve incidents. Engineered with zero-trust RBAC route guards, Angular Signals, and robust lifecycle tracking.

highlights.title: Role-Based Access
highlights.description: Multi-tiered functional route guards (`authGuard`, `rolesGuard`) enforcing permissions for administrators, users, and support staff.

highlights.title: Incident Lifecycle
highlights.description: Create, assign, track, and update incidents through clearly defined statuses and dynamic resolution date tracking.

highlights.title: Reusable Architecture
highlights.description: Strict smart/presentational component separation and encapsulated HTTP service layers ensuring high maintainability.

title: Environmental Services Landing Page
description: A high-performance, enterprise-grade Static Site Generated (SSG) landing page built with Angular 22, achieving optimal PageSpeed performance and search visibility.

highlights.title: Static Pre-rendering (SSG)
highlights.description: Pre-compiles paths via `app.routes.server.ts` (`RenderMode.Prerender`) for efficient static delivery and zero-flicker hydration.

highlights.title: Optimal Core Web Vitals
highlights.description: Achieves top-tier 100/100 scores across Performance, SEO, and Best Practices with sub-second FCP (0.9s) and LCP (1.1s).

highlights.title: RTL-First Corporate Layout
highlights.description: Structured specifically for Right-to-Left language directionality with responsive off-canvas navigation and secure inquiry forms.

title: Project Competition Platform
description: An enterprise-grade innovation challenge platform providing full lifecycle management for participant registrations, project submissions, dynamic CRUD administration, and real-time dashboard analytics.

highlights.title: Layered Clean Architecture
highlights.description: Strict decoupling across core singletons, shared presentation components, and isolated feature route modules.

highlights.title: Advanced Reactive Validations
highlights.description: Custom cross-field validators including date range comparisons (`CompareDateValidator`), password matching, and numeric input restrictions.

highlights.title: Deferred UI Loading
highlights.description: Optimized runtime performance utilizing native Angular `@defer` blocks with fallback skeletons and component input binding.

title: PWA News Reader Application
description: A modern, high-performance Progressive Web Application delivering native app-like news reading experiences with offline-first capabilities and fine-grained reactive signals.

highlights.title: Offline-First PWA Architecture
highlights.description: Configured Angular Service Worker (`ngsw-config.json`) managing static asset prefetching and data endpoint freshness caching strategies.

highlights.title: Fine-Grained Signals & OnPush
highlights.description: Optimized change detection combined with read-only signal projections for minimal render overhead across all components.

highlights.title: Custom Reactive Pipes
highlights.description: Instantaneous multi-level client-side filtering via pure transformation pipes (`CategoryPipe` and `SearchFilterPipe`).
